title: serving-runtime-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-01
content:
TODO/Notes (quick)
- Morning triage:
  - p99 spike on staging between 09:12-09:25 (saw in console). Investigate root cause before standup.
  - Affected: small-batch short-seq requests (<=64 tokens) to llama-13b-fp16-cpu-fused (hosted replica).
  - Quick check: autoscaler events show small surge of burst traffic from integration test bot around 09:10. But p99 still higher than expected after scale-out.

- Repro steps (local):
  1) curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"llama-13b","input":"lorem ipsum"}' repeated 500x with concurrency 40
  2) run profiler: ./tools/latency-profiler --conn 40 --seq 64 --model llama-13b
  3) check /metrics for tail-latency histograms (exporter: svc/latency-exporter)

- Quick triage notes:
  - Kernel suspects: switched to fused-attn-v2 last night in canary (PR #456). Fused path shows regressions for short sequences on A100-40GB with cu117 drivers.
  - KV-cache path unchanged. But observed larger memcpy counts in profiler (maybe extra sync).
  - Hypothesis: fused-attn-v2 triggers additional CUDA stream sync when batchsize small -> increases tail latency.
  - Repro locally on a100-small: yes, p99 increases ~18%. Disabled fused-attn-v2 flag lowers p99 to baseline.

- Immediate mitigations:
  - Rollback fused-attn-v2 on canary lane (manual flag disable) -> Samir to run at 10:00 (assigned).
  - Add circuit-breaker rule: if p99 > 300ms for 5m, route to fused-attn-v1 variant. Ops ticket: RW-1427 (created).

- Perf TODOs (short):
  - Add micro-bench harness for short-seq workloads (<=64 tokens) across kernels (v1, v2, triton) -> target: morning next week
  - Enhance profiler to separately attribute CUDA stream sync/wait_time per kernel call (low priority but helpful)
  - Run quantized-llama-8bit profiles to compare latency/throughput tradeoffs for small-batch traffic (ticket: RW-1432)

- Kernel notes (dev reminders):
  - fused-attn-v2: check commit diff around workspace allocation (commit: 8f3b2d). Might be extra cudaEventRecord/cudaEventSynchronize on fallback path.
  - Triton kernels: check kernel-launch config that pads threads for small B to avoid divergent warps. Could be worth test patch to reduce warp divergence cost.
  - Memory: observed small increase in transient GPU mem by ~120MB under v2 (maybe due to temp buffers). Track down buffer lifetimes.

- Tests to add:
  - unit test: fused-attn-v2 fallback path coverage for sequences 1..64 (edgecases: seq=1, seq=8, seq=64)
  - perf test: synthetic short-seq benchmark with concurrency sweep 1..128 -> record p50/p90/p99 and throughput

- Notes for release engineering / rollout:
  - Canary rollout strategy needs a quick abort path. Add runtime flag toggles & alerting hook in console that can flip kernel variant per lane.
  - Documented in runbook draft: confluence page RW-runbooks/fused-attn-rollback (stub exists, needs steps + screenshots)

- Misc kernel TODOs (low priority):
  - Try replacing cudaMemcpyAsync+cudaEvent->sync with cudaStreamWaitEvent where appropriate.
  - Evaluate using cudaGraph for repeated short-seq flows to reduce launch overhead (experiment: graph-run-03).

- Personal TODO (today):
  - 09:30 standup (report canary rollback and next steps)
  - 10:00 coordinate with Samir on rollback and run quick smoke tests
  - 11:30 pair with Maya to write unit tests for fused-attn fallback
  - 14:00 review perf harness PR from Jin (GH PR #462)
  - 16:30 update runbook + add alert threshold to console dashboard

- Observability notes:
  - Dashboard to adjust: per-model p99 by seq-length bucket (0-8,9-32,33-64,65-256) -> current bucketing too coarse
  - Add tag for kernel-variant in traces/spans so we can quickly correlate latency to kernel path (span tag: kernel.variant)

- Questions / open items:
  - Is there any backward compatibility issue with disabling fused-attn-v2 for models that rely on it for numeric stability? (check with research)
  - Who owns the quantization perf tracking? cc: Maya (assigned to follow-up)

- Links for follow-up:
  - GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/456
  - Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-1427
  - Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234567/p1647382910

Quick log (timeline):
- 09:05: noticed p99 bump in alerting (alert threshold 250ms).
- 09:12-09:25: spike window.
- 09:35: reproduced locally and validated fused-attn-v2 correlated.
- 09:50: created RJ ticket RW-1427, pinged Samir and Maya.

End of scratchpad.
